rule_text: Bonus offers for casino-style or slot games must not be promoted to the DEU market; sports-betting bonuses are permitted subject to terms rules. Interpretation (v1.1): if the page promotes no bonus offer for casino-style or slot games, this rule is NOT_APPLICABLE.

No claims of guaranteed winnings or risk-free gambling in any wording. Interpretation (v1.1): this covers any claim that the player will win or profit for certain, or cannot lose (for example "guaranteed profit", "risk-free", "lose nothing"), including when the claim is backed by a refund or cashback. A factual statement of refund or cashback terms that does not claim the player cannot lose is not covered, and neither is a slogan that promises no outcome.
Live-casino products must not be promoted to the DEU market. Interpretation (v1.1): if the page has no live-casino content, this rule is NOT_APPLICABLE.
Any permitted sports-betting bonus must state its wagering requirement and expiry.
Odds boosts must state the base odds alongside the boosted odds.

The page must display an addiction-help notice and a minimum-age statement (18+). Interpretation (v1.1): a visible line of text that names a gambling-help resource (for example "Help available at ...") counts as the addiction-help notice.

Pages promoting deposit-based play must reference the cross-operator monthly deposit limit. Interpretation (v1.1): promoting deposit-based play means promoting a named operator, a specific real-money gambling product (for example a casino game, live casino or a sportsbook) or an offer, with or without a bonus. General betting content that names no operator, product or offer is not covered.
A page targeting the DEU market and promoting operators or offers must display a DEU licence reference line.
